description: G7 Charter Rider §2(d) per-work Wellbecoming framing scan. R1 manual per-work review (reviewer DID + reasoning); R2+ rule-encoded auto-flag heuristics route to Council Lv6+ ≥3 queue. Pre-1929 works with US Southern setting / WWI+WWII newsreels / 1920s exotic travelogue / pre-1955 advertising = auto-flag categories. Verdict enum: admit / admit-with-context (requires Council Lv6+ ≥3) / exclude. Manual override path preserved at all R-phases.

scanPhase.description: R1 = manual review; R2+ rule-encoded auto-flag; R3+ baien-distill wellbecoming-framing specialist model auto-scoring; manual-override = curator overrides auto-flag

autoFlagCategoriesTriggered.description: R2+ rule-encoded heuristic triggers; admin → Council Lv6+ ≥3 queue

verdict.description: admit = no framing context required; admit-with-context = Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation REQUIRED + context document referenced; exclude = not admitted to e7m-dataset bucket

reviewerDids.description: ≥1 reviewer DID for R1 manual; ≥3 Council Lv6+ DIDs if verdict = 'admit-with-context'

reviewerReasoningCid.description: IPFS CID of reviewer reasoning document; explains why verdict was chosen

councilLv6PlusAttestations.description: Required if verdict = 'admit-with-context': Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestations

frameworkContextDocumentCid.description: Required if verdict = 'admit-with-context': IPFS CID of context-framing document that downstream consumers MUST surface (e.g., 'this 1925 newsreel includes racial caricature; framing context for manabi curriculum: ...')

baienDistillSpecialistScore.description: R3+ optional: baien-distill wellbecoming-framing specialist model auto-score in basis points (0 = clear / 10000 = strong flag); >7000 triggers Council Lv6+ ≥3 queue

manualOverrideAttested.description: true if curator manually overrode auto-flag decision; manualOverrideReasoningCid REQUIRED

manualOverrideReasoningCid.description: Required if manualOverrideAttested = true: IPFS CID of manual-override reasoning
